title: Remote Customer Support Associate
description: BrightDesk Solutions is hiring entry-level and experienced customer support associates to join a fully remote team supporting US-based clients. No prior call-center background is required — paid training covers everything from the ticketing system to tone-of-voice guidelines.

The role covers live chat and email support, roughly 20 to 35 hours a week, with shifts you can pick from a weekly availability grid. Most associates work from a laptop and a stable internet connection; no dedicated home office is required to get started.
Pay starts at an hourly rate with a review after the first 30 days. US residents 18 and older can apply; a brief written assessment is used in place of a phone interview for the first round.

title: $100 Retailer Gift Card Reward
description: ClearPath Rewards is running a limited-availability offer for a $100 gift card at a major US retailer, available to new members who complete a short profile and confirm their email address.

There's no purchase required to qualify. After the profile step, a short set of preference questions helps match you with any additional partner offers you may also want to see — these are optional and can be skipped.
Rewards are issued electronically once the profile is verified, typically within a few business days. Offer is limited to US residents 18 and older, one claim per household.

title: Remote Data Entry Clerk — Flexible Hours
description: Ledgerline Admin Co. is looking for detail-oriented data entry clerks to help process routine records for small business clients. The role is fully remote and self-paced within weekly deadlines, making it a good fit alongside other work or school.

Tasks include transcribing structured information from scanned documents into a shared spreadsheet template, plus a basic accuracy check on each batch before submission. Full instructions and a practice batch are provided before your first paid assignment.
This is a 1099 contractor role paid per completed batch. No prior admin experience is required, though comfort with spreadsheets is helpful. Open to US-based applicants only.

title: $50 Grocery Gift Card — New Member Offer
description: Homefront Perks is offering a $50 grocery gift card to new members who sign up and verify their address. It's aimed at US households looking to offset weekly grocery costs.
Signup takes about two minutes: your name, a valid US mailing address, and an email to send the confirmation link to. There is no subscription or recurring charge attached to this specific offer.
Once verified, the gift card code is emailed within 5–7 business days. Limited to one per household; must be a US resident aged 18 or older to claim.

title: Virtual Bilingual Interpreter (Spanish/English)
description: LinguaBridge Network connects fluent Spanish/English speakers with on-demand phone and video interpretation sessions for healthcare and customer service calls. Work is scheduled around your own availability.

Interpreters log in through a web portal during selected time blocks and are paid per minute of active call time. A short language proficiency screening and a background check are required before your first shift.
This role is open to US-based bilingual speakers 18 and older with a quiet space to take calls. A headset and reliable internet are the only equipment requirements.

title: $25 Streaming Service Gift Card
description: WeekendClaim is offering a $25 gift card redeemable at a popular streaming service, aimed at US residents signing up for the first time this week.

The offer involves completing a short entertainment-preferences survey — about 6 questions — followed by an email confirmation step. Survey answers are used only to route you to relevant follow-up offers, which are optional.
Codes are sent electronically after verification, usually same-day. One claim per email address; US residents 18+ only.

title: Remote Social Media Moderator
description: Northlight Media Group is hiring content moderators to review flagged posts and comments across client social accounts, ensuring community guidelines are followed. Training includes a walkthrough of the moderation guidebook and escalation process.

Shifts are 4–8 hours and can be scheduled in advance through a self-service calendar; weekend and evening slots are usually the most available. Moderators work independently but have a team lead on call for edge cases.
Pay is hourly with a two-week onboarding period at a training rate. Applicants must be US-based, 18 or older, and comfortable reviewing a range of user-generated content.

title: $75 Gas Station Gift Card Offer
description: RoadReady Rewards is running a fuel-cost relief offer: a $75 gift card usable at participating gas stations nationwide, aimed at commuters and rideshare drivers in the US.

To qualify, complete the registration form with your name and a valid mailing address, then confirm via the link sent to your email. No vehicle information or payment details are ever requested as part of this offer.
Delivery is electronic and typically arrives within a week of verification. Limited to US residents 18 and older, one per household.

title: Freelance Transcription Reviewer
description: ClearType Transcripts needs reviewers to proofread machine-generated transcripts against short audio clips and correct any errors before delivery to clients. Most files run 5–15 minutes long.
Work is picked up in batches through a contributor dashboard, so you choose how much to take on each week. A short qualification test — one sample file — determines your starting rate tier.
This is a flexible, self-directed freelance role open to US-based English speakers 18 and older with strong attention to detail. Payments are issued weekly for completed batches.
